title: Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXII OF 2018
ACT XXII OF 2018
PUNJAB GOVERNMENT SERVANTS HOUSING
FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Punjab Government Servants
Housing Foundation Act, 2004
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th May, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(192)/2018/1768, dated 24.5.2018.---The
Punjab Government Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Bill 2018, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 16, 2018, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May 21, 2018, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Punjab Government
Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2004 (X of 2004) for purposes of making
provision for disposal of houses and plots to the in-service Government
Servants on their attaining the specified age and for incidental matters.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as
follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Punjab Government
Servants Housing Foundation (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

It is necessary further to amend the Punjab Government

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as

3. Amendment in
section 16 of Act X of 2004.---In the Act, in section
16, for the Proviso, the following shall be substituted:
"Provided that in case the number of houses or plots
exceeds the above requirement, they may be disposed of, in the prescribed
manner, in favour of the serving members who are not less than fifty eight
years of age.".
